description_en: Updates the ubiquitous network access credential applied for by the current user account
description_zh: 更新当前用户账号所申请的泛在入网凭证
name: UpdateRoamingJoinPermission

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ubiquitous network access credential to update
parameters.help_zh: 要更新的泛在入网凭证的ID
parameters.name: join_permission_id

parameters.help_en: The custom name of the network access credential, used to replace the old name
parameters.help_zh: 自定义入网凭证名称，用于更新旧名称
parameters.name: join_permission_name

parameters.help_en: The receive window delay for Class A, in ms
parameters.help_zh: class A的接收窗口延时，单位为ms
parameters.name: rx_delay

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique identifier for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
